records.title: Circle launches Arc mainnet with StableFX, Circle Payments Network integration and institutional validator cohort
records.summary: Circle's official release says Arc launched with native USDC gas, sub-second finality, more than 100 applications and more than 100 institutional/ecosystem builders. StableFX provides 24/7 programmable FX settlement and lists 22 local stablecoins as active or onboarding: USDC, EURC, AUDD, AUDF, BRLA, CADD, CHFAU, EURAU, GBPA, JPYC, KRW1, MXNB, QCAD, SEKAU, TRYB, wARS, wBRL, wCLP, wCOP, wMXN, wPEN and ZARU. Circle Payments Network is integrated natively into Arc. Circle names USYC, BUIDL, private-credit funds and cirBTC as assets to trade, lend and post as collateral. SBI Group is in the founding validator cohort; Coinbase, Binance and Upbit are listed as exchange-access partners. SBI's CEO says the group intends to leverage both USDC and JPYSC in its APAC collaboration with Circle.
records.limitations: The release is a company statement. 'Active or onboarding' does not mean all 22 routes are live or have measurable volume. SBI's mention of USDC and JPYSC does not establish JPYSC on the 22-currency StableFX list; JPYC is listed, JPYSC is not. Exchange access does not mean validator status. No XRP/Arc integration or XRP displacement is stated.

records.title: Risk Stewards: Temporary Slope2 Reductions on Aave V3 and Aave V4 / 2026.10.30
records.summary: LlamaRisk reports post-freeze utilization between 92% and 100% on several stablecoin reserves. Its 00:26 UTC data table reports Aave V3 Horizon RLUSD supplied at $86M and 94.1% utilization, with current borrow APR 15.2%, proposed 7.1% at current utilization and 10% at full utilization. Aave V4 Arc Core USDC shows $109M in the 'Added' column, 100% utilization and current drawn APR 14.1%, with a proposed 10% rate. Horizon was not frozen because its collateral is permissioned. The disclosure is explicit that reserve supply/utilization is not a measure of XRP collateral.
records.limitations: LlamaRisk is a DeFi risk service provider funded in part by the Aave DAO, not an independent auditor. The V4 table's 'Added' field must not be relabelled as collateral or current outstanding deposits. Reserve supply and utilization do not establish the identity of borrowers or that all supplied assets are posted as collateral.

records.title: Risk Stewards: Borrow and Draw Cap Reductions on Aave V3 and Aave V4 / 2026.10.30
records.summary: LlamaRisk recommends and reports execution planning for borrow/draw cap reductions sized about 2% above pre-exploit borrow levels. It states the changes remove approximately $3.7B of unused Aave V3 borrow capacity and $130M of Aave V4 draw capacity. On Aave V4 Arc, USDC draw caps are reduced from $100M to $69.7M on the Main Spoke and from $60M to $41.6M on the USDC Maple Spoke. The source provides pre-exploit and current debt values and notes a 36-hour cooldown after each cap update.
records.limitations: Cap reductions are changes to borrowing headroom, not cash withdrawals or realized losses. The figures are risk-steward disclosures, not an independent audit of every on-chain position. Do not interpret removed unused capacity as capital leaving Aave.

records.publisher: Aave official account, mirrored by Teapawt
records.title: Aave reports V3 and V4 markets unfrozen; nine assets remain at LTV zero
records.summary: The public mirror of Aave's @aave account displays a post stating that all Aave V3 and V4 markets are unfrozen and contracts were unaffected. A follow-up post says USDT, USDC, USDT0, POL, WAVAX, sAVAX, XAUT, PAXG and OP temporarily remain at LTV 0 so they cannot back new borrows. The mirror also displays Aave's October 27 statement that V4 active loans crossed $500M.
records.limitations: This is a third-party mirror of the official account, not a direct X permalink. The Aave governance forum separately documents the four-wave unfreeze plan and LTV/collateral-factor rules. LTV 0 removes new borrowing power; it is not equivalent to an asset freeze or a blanket protocol shutdown.

records.title: Official Proof of Reserves page and Download All Address control
records.summary: The official page exposes a 'Download All Address' control. Binance describes its PoR process as wallet-ownership verification, a snapshot of user balances, zk-SNARK proof generation and Merkle-tree construction. It says reserves cover assets held in custody for users and includes hot and cold wallet ownership verification.
records.limitations: The page's dynamic download control does not expose its target URL in the retrieved static page, and the Audit Time field is blank in the extracted page. No address file was downloaded in this run. No conclusion is possible about whether the five compromised XRPL wallets were in the October 1 XRP PoR set.

records.title: XRP ETF flow dashboard through October 29, 2026
records.summary: Alpha Finance reports +$8.4M XRP ETF net flow for October 29 across five of five funds, +$98.9M over 30 sessions and $1.73B cumulative net inflows. It reports a $1.3255 XRP reference close for October 29. The page says fund list, AUM, holdings and fees are not published in its table.
records.limitations: This is an aggregator, not an issuer filing. Its five-fund universe differs from trackers including six spot funds and BITW. The $1.3255 reference close differs from other provider references for the same date. ETF flows are not total XRP market demand.

records.title: XRP ETF daily holdings and flows data through October 29, 2026
records.summary: XRP Insights reports +6.40M XRP flow on October 29 across six spot funds plus BITW, total holdings of 1,196,650,118 XRP including BITW, $1.56B net assets, and +3.44M XRP over October 26-29. Its Oct29 reference price is about $1.25. The tracker states GXRP is excluded from flow totals while its holdings remain included during a data-gap correction.
records.limitations: The dataset is a third-party reconstruction from issuer-reported holdings and contains excluded/reconstructed row states. Its fund universe and XRP reference price differ from Alpha Finance. The $1.71 average-cost estimate is methodology-derived, not an issuer-reported figure.

records.title: XRP ETF flows for October 29, 2026, partial T+1 data
records.summary: CryptoETF.today reports +$7.1M net inflow for October 29, with four of five funds reported and GXRP missing. It reports $1.46B net assets, $1.81B cumulative net flow and an October 29 close of $1.28.
records.limitations: The October 29 figure is explicitly partial T+1 and recomputed as fund reports arrive. Its fund coverage, net-asset definition and reference price differ from Alpha Finance and XRP Insights.

records.title: XRP market, futures and open-interest dashboard
records.summary: The page displays approximately $2.83B XRP open interest, $4.80B 24-hour futures volume and $1.20B 24-hour spot volume at retrieval. The retrieved summary does not expose the exact venue/contract universe or a precise UTC observation cutoff.
records.limitations: The displayed OI is not directly comparable with Coinalyze's approximately $1.1B series, which includes only XRP/USD, XRP/USDT and XRP/USDC and is not real-time, or TradRadar's earlier seven-exchange snapshot. Do not average provider totals.

records.title: Wall Street closes sharply lower as AI cash-burn fears spark technology selloff
records.summary: Reuters reports the Nasdaq fell 2.86%, the S&P 500 1.82% and the Dow 1.09% on October 30 as Intel/Amazon results intensified concerns about AI spending returns. Reuters also notes crypto-related equities fell amid reports of the Binance hack.
records.limitations: Equity index declines are a macro risk-regime confounder, not proof of XRP-specific causation. No synchronized BTC/ETH/XRP event study was executed in this run.
